title: Current LibreDWG failure shapes and local AC1024 disposition split
mode: Primary-source web research and local diagnostic conversion; plan update only
scope: Refresh current LibreDWG issue/PR status for output closure, owned-entity traversal, block ownership, string framing, AcDs carrier preservation, and DXF import edge cases.
Cross-check current ezdxf documentation for unsupported-record and 3D semantic evidence limits.
Re-triage nine user-held AC1024 DWG samples without copying them into the repository.
Turn observations into focused implementation-ready deltas while preserving strict conversion defaults and validation frequency.

sources.revision: Issue/PR state reviewed 2026-10-20; PR #1360 remained open
sources.observed: The issue reports a DWG-to-DXF output ending before ENTITIES/EOF with exit status zero. The open PR author corrected the initial diagnosis to a failed modular-character read accepted while the handle offset was invalid; the proposed resynchronization is conditional.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-reported behavior and unmerged peer recovery code do not establish a libdxfrw defect or a general DWG recovery rule.

sources.revision: Issue/PR state reviewed 2026-10-20; PR #1359 remained open
sources.observed: The issue reports one unresolved owned-entity reference stopping a peer writer after 93 of 10,847 R2007 modelspace entities. The PR proposes distinguishing unresolved references from end-of-list.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This is a peer writer traversal report. Continue is safe only when the list/frame boundary is independently known; it is not a local reader result or permission for heuristic scanning.

sources.revision: Mutable issue pages reviewed 2026-10-20; peer reports identify specific named builds/operations
sources.observed: #1409 reports empty block bodies from a mutable loop-index error; #1410 groups explicit-zero HATCH, unusual attribute tags, and embedded-MTEXT DXF-import behavior; #1411 reports R2013+ AcDs/SAB carrier loss with modeler shells retained; #1412 reports transformed-string termination and empty-value framing, with two linked fix commits while the issue page remains open.
sources.evidenceCeiling: These are peer issue reports and commits, not local reproductions or proof of a published-release fix. The plan already owns generated local controls for these shape families; no duplicate test is warranted.

sources.revision: Mutable master documentation reviewed 2026-10-20; NEWS identifies 0.14.1 beta dated 2026-07-25
sources.observed: The NEWS lists security/bounds and parser fixes; the manual separately identifies stable, partial, unhandled, and untested object families.
sources.evidenceCeiling: A version badge or repository-level claim does not establish a per-object, direction-specific, semantic, or native-consumer result.

sources.observed: The xref module documents unsupported entities/features that may be ignored while unknown entities/objects can be wrapped as tag storage. The drawing backend documents no 3D engine and no ACIS rendering.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Useful as an exact-profile DXF or carrier observer, not as a complete-record preservation or arbitrary ACIS/B-rep semantic oracle.

sources.observed: Nine local AC1024 files were converted with debug tracing into temporary paths. Five reached readDwgClasses END, had successful reader outcome and all observed frames published with no entity/object parse failures, but were refused by strict-complete preflight (three semanticCoverage=partial-observed, two unknown). Four visualization files logged a class-section CRC mismatch and then failed at sticky BAD_READ_BLOCKS numeric 10 with partial frame publication/unresolved frames. None reproduced BAD_READ_CLASSES numeric 8 in this cohort.
sources.evidenceCeiling: This is a diagnostic on user-held local samples, not a general AC1024 claim or root-cause proof. The CRC warning does not establish that the high-size word is causal; no sample was copied or committed.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-06/PAR-07/S8: converter output closure, atomic publication, terminal EOF, and per-source loss disposition
PAR-07/7G: block, layout, and owner/reference closure
PAR-14: bounded record parsing, recovery boundaries, and stable first-error stage
PAR-19/PAR-28: zero-valued HATCH, attribute-tag, and embedded-MTEXT local controls
Strict-versus-partial conversion: separate read completeness from owner-closure policy, preserving strict defaults
assessment.planImpact: Separate read completeness from graph closure, keep strict conversion default, map current peer issues only to existing owners, and investigate the AC1024 class CRC/block-stage cohort from spec plus trace without copying external samples.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source web research and local diagnostic conversion; plan/receipt update only
method.limitations: Peer issue bodies and master documentation are mutable. Local AC1024 files were user-held outside the repository. The sample audit is not an exhaustive corpus pass and does not establish a file-format rule or a CRC root cause.
